sourceCheckedReasons.reason: Both accurately report ruled/lined pages and preserve the same unresolved college-versus-wide distinction. Neither omits a supported answer to the actual question.

Both preserve the qualitative positive shipping anecdotes without inventing days or extending the other customer's deadline to this order. The full pool adds no generally applicable shipping interval.

The extra full-pool color reports were unavailable to both during generation and do not establish a clean alternative inventory.

A adds the supported muted descriptor, while B states incompleteness more explicitly; neither resolves the additional full-pool color variation. The descriptor alone is insufficient for a material substantive win here.

Both answer no and support the same polyurethane/non-air-filled construction. A's indicates and B's so do not create a meaningful calibration difference given the actual no-air evidence and corroborating full pool.

B adds useful generic-characterization context, but its claim of conflict is not established by those compatible reports. This preference is based on relevant compatibility information, not length or fewer repeated citations. Neither answer establishes physical-world operation for SCPH-77004.

A omits that useful condition and mainly contrasts an unrelated exact model with a broad unverified claim. Both correctly avoid an exact-model guarantee; B's useful supported condition gives it the substantive advantage.

Both correctly preserve the missing component-to-material relationship and avoid transferring plastic or metal statements to the requested plate. B’s additional blade-guard example is supported but does not resolve the question; A’s fewer examples are sufficient to explain the same source gap.

decision.reason: One agreed substantive preference and one disputed benefit across eight products is limited exploratory AI evidence. Broad correctness improvement, human-reviewed quality and whole-workflow correction benefit remain unestablished.

limitations: Small single-observation eight-product comparison with no stochastic repeats.
AI reviewers may share correlated errors; agreement is not human gold or external truth.
Anonymous labels conceal assignment, but writing style may reveal it.
Reference inaccuracies were discovered after generation and explicitly retained/corrected; no silent reference replacement.
Literal quote membership is separate from semantic support, source-consistent correctness and human-reviewed quality.
